title: migrate meta --stored does not list a stored connector_action whose connectorConfig.input carries a template token, though boot refuses it
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

Filing gate: ② should-fix ④.2 of the contract review of PR #28150 (#27968), record 6525595405. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.

Reach: an operator upgrading a deployment whose stored flows include a `connector_action` with a `{…}` token in `connectorConfig.input`. `os migrate meta --stored` is the tool that lists stored rows the new release refuses, and it will not name that row. `registerFlow` refuses it at boot. The ADR-0087 D3 entry names the boot warning as the locator, so the operator does have a path, but the listing tool's promise is broken.

## Measured (on the #28150 head `6a06a420`)

- `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts:406`: the detector `flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused` calls `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals(node.type, node.config)`. It walks `config` only and never hands the node, so the new `connectorConfig · input.*` ledger entry is never read.
- The header's invariant reads "a site is listed here exactly when that door refuses it". After #28150 there is a hole in it.

## What changes

- Hand the node to the judge, reading the same ledger, with the `connectorConfig` path prefix.
- Add a test: a stored `connector_action` row with `input: { text: '{record.name}' }` is listed at `connectorConfig.input.text`, plus a control in which a CEL envelope is not listed.
- This lands after #28150 merges.

Links: #27968, PR #28150 (record 6525595405).

Blocked-by: #28150
